testcase.name: [sig-node] [DRA] control plane supports init containers
[sig-api-machinery] ResourceQuota should create a ResourceQuota and capture the life of a persistent volume claim with a storage class
[sig-node] [DRA] kubelet [Feature:DynamicResourceAllocation] on single node supports reusing resources
[sig-apps] Job should adopt matching orphans and release non-matching pods [Conformance]
[sig-api-machinery] ValidatingAdmissionPolicy [Privileged:ClusterAdmin] should support ValidatingAdmissionPolicy API operations [Conformance]
[sig-apps] DisruptionController Listing PodDisruptionBudgets for all namespaces should list and delete a collection of PodDisruptionBudgets [Conformance]

[sig-node] PLR Pod InPlace Resize [FeatureGate:InPlacePodLevelResourcesVerticalScaling] [Beta] PLR pod-level burstable pods - 1 container with all requests & limits set and resize policy cpu restart resizing cpu limits
[sig-node] Pods should be updated [NodeConformance] [Conformance]
[sig-api-machinery] AdmissionWebhook [Privileged:ClusterAdmin] should be able to deny custom resource creation, update and deletion [Conformance]
[sig-apps] Deployment deployment should support rollover [Conformance]
[sig-instrumentation] MetricsGrabber should grab all metrics slis from API server.
[sig-node] Override hostname of Pod [NodeConformance] [FeatureGate:HostnameOverride] [Beta] a pod with hostNetwork and hostnameOverride fields will fail to be created
[sig-api-machinery] ResourceQuota [Feature:PodPriority] should verify ResourceQuota's priority class scope (quota set to pod count: 1) against 2 pods with different priority class.
[sig-api-machinery] Server request timeout default timeout should be used if the specified timeout in the request URL is 0s
[sig-node] PLR Pod InPlace Resize [FeatureGate:InPlacePodLevelResourcesVerticalScaling] [Beta] burstable pods - extended resize with equivalents [MinimumKubeletVersion:1.34]
[sig-api-machinery] Garbage collector should delete pods created by rc when not orphaning [Conformance]
[sig-node] Downward API [Feature:PodLevelResources] [FeatureGate:PodLevelResources] [Beta] Downward API tests for pod level resources should provide default limits.cpu/memory from pod level resources
[sig-cli] Kubectl client Kubectl expose should create services for rc [Conformance]

[sig-node] PLR Pod InPlace Resize [FeatureGate:InPlacePodLevelResourcesVerticalScaling] [Beta] PLR pod-level burstable pods - 1 container with all requests & limits set and resize policy mem restart resizing mem limits
[sig-node] [NodeConformance] [FeatureGate:SidecarContainers] Probing restartable init container should have monotonically increasing restart count
[sig-node] Downward API should provide host IP and pod IP as an env var if pod uses host network [LinuxOnly] [NodeConformance]
[sig-node] [DRA] control plane supports reusing resources
[sig-apps] Job should mark indexes as failed when the FailIndex action is matched in podFailurePolicy [Conformance]

[sig-api-machinery] CRDValidationRatcheting [Privileged:ClusterAdmin] [FeatureGate:CRDValidationRatcheting] MUST NOT fail to update a resource due to JSONSchema errors on unchanged correlatable fields
[sig-apps] Deployment RecreateDeployment should delete old pods and create new ones [Conformance]
[sig-api-machinery] AdmissionWebhook [Privileged:ClusterAdmin] patching/updating a mutating webhook should work [Conformance]

[sig-node] PLR Pod InPlace Resize [FeatureGate:InPlacePodLevelResourcesVerticalScaling] [Beta] PLR pod-level burstable pods - 1 container with all requests & limits set and resize policy no restart resizing all resources in the same direction

[sig-node] PLR Pod InPlace Resize [FeatureGate:InPlacePodLevelResourcesVerticalScaling] [Beta] PLR guaranteed qos - 1 container with resize policy cpu & mem restart + resize initContainers resizing only pod-level mem

[sig-apps] StatefulSet Basic StatefulSet functionality [StatefulSetBasic] should perform canary updates and phased rolling updates of template modifications for partiton1 and delete pod-0 without failing container

[sig-node] PLR Pod InPlace Resize [FeatureGate:InPlacePodLevelResourcesVerticalScaling] [Beta] PLR pod-level burstable pods - 1 container with all requests & limits set and resize policy cpu restart resizing pod-level cpu & mem in opposite directions
